questions.q: What three types of hackers does the author name?
o: White hat, black hat and grey hat
questions.e: In the video: "white hat hakeri... black hat hakeri... i postoje grey hat hakeri, koji su zapravo nešto između" — white hat hackers... black hat hackers... and there are grey hat hackers, who are actually something in between.

questions.q: What needs to be done first?
o: Come up with a cool hacker name
questions.e: In the video: "Prvo što je potrebno je da smislite cool hacking ime. Zašto? Zato što onda izgledate opasno." — the first thing needed is to come up with a cool hacking name. Why? Because then you look dangerous.

questions.q: What, according to the author, shows that you are smarter and a better hacker?
questions.e: In the video: "što više slova zamenite brojevima, to znači da ste inteligentniji i da ste bolji haker" — the more letters you replace with numbers, the more intelligent and the better hacker you are.

questions.q: Why is "Lumix" (Linux) needed?
o: The necessary tools are already installed in it
questions.e: In the video: "Zato što on ima preinstalirane tulove... poput terminala, koji su potrebni za hakovanje" — because it has preinstalled tools... like a terminal, which are needed for hacking.

questions.q: What is hidden behind the letters HS in ITHS?
questions.e: In the video: "a iza tog HS se zapravo krije high school... zapravo to HS nije za high school, već hacking school" — and behind that HS actually hides "high school"... actually that HS isn't for high school, but hacking school.

questions.q: What do you need to wear to become a professional hacker?
questions.e: In the video: "da biste postali profesionalni haker, morate imati hudi i one hakerske rukavice" — to become a professional hacker, you must have a hoodie and those hacker gloves.

questions.q: How many monitors does the "best hacker in the world" Cold Frozen have?
questions.e: In the video: "najbolji haker na svetu, Cold Frozen, ima čak 20 monitora" — the best hacker in the world, Cold Frozen, has as many as 20 monitors.

questions.q: Why don't hackers use a mouse?
o: To avoid losing time switching to a mouse
questions.e: In the video: "Ukoliko vam treba miš, vi morate tu prekinuti, preći na miša i onda se vratiti na hakovanje. I tu gubite vreme" — if you need a mouse, you have to interrupt there, switch to the mouse and then go back to hacking. And that's where you lose time.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Svaki *klinac* sanja da postane haker.
questions.e: Klinac — colloquial for "kid, teenager".

questions.q: Potreban vam je veliki *trud* i veliko ulaganje vremena.
questions.e: Trud — effort, diligence.

questions.q: Imamo jedan *oprez* što se tiče ovog sistema.
questions.e: Oprez — caution.

questions.q: Da li ste videli hakera koji ne nosi *kapuljaču*?
questions.e: Kapuljača — a hood.

questions.q: Postoje neke *glasine* da najbolji haker ima 20 monitora.
questions.e: Glasina — a rumor.

questions.q: Morate ići u *zatvor* ili biti bar na FBI poternici.
questions.e: Zatvor — a prison; zatvoriti — to close.

questions.q: Biti na FBI *poternici*.
questions.e: Poternica — an arrest warrant, a wanted notice.

questions.q: Kakav biste haker bili da vam desktop izgleda *uredno*?
questions.e: Uredan — neat, tidy; red — order.

questions.q: Što više slova zamenite ___, to ste bolji haker.
questions.e: Zameniti with what — instrumental case: slova zamenite brojevima.

questions.q: Prvo što je potrebno je da ___ cool hacking ime.
questions.e: Addressing "you", plural: da smislite.

questions.q: Uz pomoć tih ___ možete hakovati bilo koju vladu.
questions.e: Uz pomoć ("with the help of") requires the genitive case: tih tulova.

questions.q: Najbolje je da upišete neku hacking ___.
questions.e: Upisati what — accusative case: školu.

questions.q: Verovatno i ta škola mora biti ___.
questions.e: The adjective agrees with školom — feminine, nominative case: nelegalna.

questions.q: Naučite da ne koristite ___.
questions.e: Koristiti what — accusative case. For animate masculine nouns it coincides with the genitive: miša.

questions.q: Hakujte u što manje ___.
questions.e: After što manje the genitive case is used: što manje svetla.

questions.q: Treba da slušate hakersku ___.
questions.e: Slušati what — accusative case: hakersku muziku.
